backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with user data types, initial settings, and persistent maps for tasks, timers, profiles, and shop-related data.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a migration function that replaces the old 'Sigma Student 🗿' rank with 'Topper Student🏆' in persistent level ranks.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata mapping features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries of many frontend components and utilities for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based OKLCH color variables and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading the Scholar Gold app and favicon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with authentication handling, theme switching, background rendering, and a placeholder screen while backend setup is incomplete.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: Empty file placeholder for background settings component.
frontend/src/components/DailyGoalProgres: Empty file placeholder for daily goal progress card component.
frontend/src/components/DailySyllabusRem: Empty file placeholder for syllabus reminder notifications component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing copyright, branding, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Empty file placeholder for app header component.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays the main login screen UI and triggers Internet Identity login with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppBackground.ts: Manages per-user app background settings stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and handles login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base, component, and utility layers plus theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/src/utils/withTimeout.ts: Wraps a promise with a timeout that rejects if it exceeds a specified duration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color mappings, animations, and plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, environment variable injection, chunk splitting, and a dev proxy, with aliases and a build-size reporter.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing cosmetic-profile features, their versions, related requirements, and pending feature requests.
